# Transcript to PDF for YouTube

> Manifest V3 Chrome extension that fetches a YouTube video's transcript from its URL and exports it as a formatted PDF, entirely in the browser with no server, API key or third-party service.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): Features, install, how transcripts are fetched, architecture table, permissions, limitations
- [docs/onboarding.md](docs/onboarding.md): A first-hour path through the codebase
- [docs/COMPONENTS.md](docs/COMPONENTS.md): Every module, its exports and dependencies

- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): The proof-of-origin constraint, the two strategies, design decisions
